HAPPY PET HARBOR

Store information

Who we are

Happy Pet Harbor is an online pet supplies store operated by RaeHouser Trading LLC. Our collection features padded handle rope leashes in blue, pink and lime green.

How to enquire about a purchase

Email houserchiu@gmail.com with your preferred color, quantity and delivery country. We will confirm availability and purchase details with you. Sending an enquiry does not place an order or reserve stock.

Products and payment

View our rope leash on the product page. The leash is 1.5 m long and 1.0 cm wide, priced at $5.00 USD. Register or sign in to add products to your account cart and save a shipping address. Purchase enquiries are handled by email. This website does not collect payments; please do not send card details by email.

Shipping and returns

Our rope leash includes free shipping and will ship from Addison, Illinois, USA. Orders are processed within 1–3 business days after successful payment and order confirmation. Standard transit to the contiguous 48 states is estimated at 3–7 business days after dispatch. Return requests may be made within 30 days of receipt. See our shipping policy and returns and refunds policy for coverage, exceptions and full details.

Contact

For product questions and business enquiries, email houserchiu@gmail.com.
